column2: If more than one Dance of the Dead ends up on a creature
column3: Outdated (conclusion B): written for the 2004 Oracle wording (a generic "enchant creature" Aura that Aura Graft could move). The Masters Edition Update Bulletin (Mark L. Gottlieb, 2007-08-29) gave it "enchant creature put onto the battlefield with [this]", linked to its own trigger (CR 607.1a, 607.2c), so another Dance can't be moved onto the creature (303.4j) or created attached to it (707.2, 303.4i); two Dances can't share a creature (tested in tests/rulings/animate_dead.rs, a_second_dance_of_the_dead_cant_join_the_first_on_its_creature)
